scope: Same-symbol case windows are joined when their physical OHLCV time coverage intersects, across source resolutions. Each fold excludes one entire connected component.
blindness_limit: All labels were already available; these are disjoint-window cross-validation folds, not a prospective or human-blind test, and all components remain from a small number of dates.

candidate_definitions.normalized_ohlcv: C_hat = Delta * OLS(C_Lite/Delta ~ standardized [ln(n), range_bp, close_path_bp, signed_efficiency, volume_weighted_body_bp, ln1p(mean_volume), volume_HHI])
candidate_definitions.raw_ohlcv_ols_all: C_hat = OLS(C_Lite ~ standardized [ln(n), ln(Delta), range_bp, close_path_bp, signed_efficiency, volume_weighted_body_bp, ln1p(mean_volume), volume_HHI])
candidate_definitions.raw_ohlcv_ols_long_rounded: For n>=21 only: round-nearest-second OLS(C_Lite ~ same eight standardized features); training uses only n>=21 cases outside the held-out component.
